meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 lsp 系列工具调用语言服务器,对当前工作区的代码做诊断检查、跳转到定义、查找引用、列出符号,并检查重命名是否安全。
howto.when: 当你需要语言服务器诊断、定义查找、引用查找等代码分析时触发;改动之后也可用它检查单个文件或目录的错误。

say.text: 用 lsp.status 看看当前有哪些语言服务器可用
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失和启用的服务器

say.text: 对这个文件跑 lsp.diagnostics,只看 error
say.note: 返回该文件的错误级诊断

say.text: 用 lsp.find_references 找出这个符号的所有引用
say.note: 返回全工作区的引用位置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls lsp.* tools to reach language servers: check diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and verify rename safety in the current workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks; also useful after edits to check one file or directory for errors.

say_en.text: Run lsp.status to see which language servers are available.
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed, missing, and active servers.

say_en.text: Run lsp.diagnostics on this file with severity error only.
say_en.note: Returns error-level diagnostics for that file.

say_en.text: Use lsp.find_references to find all usages of this symbol.
